command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /tmp

echo "== R OLS on the bundled cars dataset, two independent ways =="
# The r env ships no Python (the catalog's first such env), so the smoke check is R.
# datasets::cars ships with r-base -- zero staging. The OLS fit is a textbook result
# (every R intro fits lm(dist ~ speed, data=cars)); the closed-form normal equations
# recompute it through a separate code path, so the two must agree.
cat > fit.R <<'EOF'
ver <- as.character(getRversion()); arch <- R.version$arch
n <- nrow(cars)
fit <- lm(dist ~ speed, data = cars)
ci <- unname(coef(fit))                     # lm(): QR decomposition
X <- cbind(1, cars$speed)
b  <- as.vector(solve(t(X) %*% X, t(X) %*% cars$dist))   # normal equations
# ecosystem is real, not bare r-base: attach tidyverse + data.table (no warning-unwind;
# suppress startup messages explicitly rather than via a handler that would swallow more)
eco <- tryCatch({ suppressMessages({library(tidyverse); library(data.table)}); TRUE },
                error = function(e) FALSE)
writeLines(c(
  sprintf("R_VERSION %s", ver),
  sprintf("R_ARCH %s", arch),
  sprintf("N_OBS %d", n),
  sprintf("LM_INTERCEPT %.6f", ci[1]),
  sprintf("LM_SLOPE %.6f", ci[2]),
  sprintf("NORMEQ_INTERCEPT %.6f", b[1]),
  sprintf("NORMEQ_SLOPE %.6f", b[2]),
  sprintf("MAX_COEF_DIFF %.3e", max(abs(ci - b))),
  sprintf("ECOSYSTEM_LOADED %s", eco)
), "fit.txt")
EOF
Rscript fit.R
cat fit.txt

echo "== smoke check =="
Rscript - <<'EOF' > smoke-check.txt || { cat smoke-check.txt; exit 1; }
kv <- setNames(as.list(sub("^\\S+ ", "", readLines("fit.txt"))),
               sub(" .*$", "", readLines("fit.txt")))
num <- function(k) as.numeric(kv[[k]])
fail <- character(0)
check <- function(label, ok, detail) {
  cat(sprintf("%-26s %s\n", label, detail))
  if (!isTRUE(ok)) fail <<- c(fail, label)
}
# shape / build
check("r_version", kv$R_VERSION == "4.5.3", paste(kv$R_VERSION, " want 4.5.3 (r45 CRAN layer)"))
check("r_arch", kv$R_ARCH == "aarch64", paste(kv$R_ARCH, " want aarch64"))
check("n_obs", num("N_OBS") == 50, paste(kv$N_OBS, " want exactly 50 (cars dataset)"))
# reference identity: canonical OLS coefficients for cars
check("ols_intercept", abs(num("LM_INTERCEPT") - (-17.579095)) < 1e-4,
      sprintf("%.6f  want -17.579095 (textbook cars OLS)", num("LM_INTERCEPT")))
check("ols_slope", abs(num("LM_SLOPE") - 3.932409) < 1e-4,
      sprintf("%.6f  want 3.932409 (textbook cars OLS)", num("LM_SLOPE")))
# internal cross-validation: lm() (QR) vs normal equations (solve) -- two code paths
check("lm_eq_normeq", num("MAX_COEF_DIFF") < 1e-8,
      sprintf("%.3e  want < 1e-8 (QR fit == normal-equations fit)", num("MAX_COEF_DIFF")))
# ecosystem present, not bare r-base
check("ecosystem_loaded", kv$ECOSYSTEM_LOADED == "TRUE",
      paste(kv$ECOSYSTEM_LOADED, " want TRUE (tidyverse + data.table attach)"))
if (length(fail)) { cat("FAILED: ", paste(fail, collapse=", "), "\n"); quit(status=1) }
EOF
cat smoke-check.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
